Steam is Holding a Massive Discount Sale for JRPG Games


Steam is holding a big discount sale for JRPG games on the platform. Simply named the “JRPG Sale”, this special discount period will continue until March 21 and includes JRPG games of various different styles.



The discounts it offers themselves are quite diverse, ranging from as low as 10% to 60%, some of which are also included for new games such as Scarlet Nexus, Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin, Chrono Trigger, Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne, and many more.



Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   In order to facilitate access to purchases, the official offer page has divided a variety of games into different selections ranging from Classic, 2D, 3D, Pixel titles, and those that carry Turn-Based gameplay. There’s quite a bit of choice in all categories.

Apart from titles that fall into the Featured category, there are hundreds of other games that are also included in the offer.
If you’ve ever added a JRPG to your wish list on Steam, this may be the best time to check it again. You may just find you can now get it for a lower price.
So like the information above, the discount period for the JRPG Sale on Steam will be available until March 21. You can check complete details and access all the offers right here.
